chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Abu Ayoub al-Khazzaz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two Imams (peace be upon them).

Regarding the Words of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'So to whomsoever then the Advice has come from his Lord, then he desists, he shall have what has already passed.' He said: 'The advice is the repentance.'

key_terms.ما سَلَف: What has passed, referring to past deeds or rewards
key_terms.مَوْعِظَة: Advice, reminder, or exhortation from God

ai.seo_question: What does the term 'maw'idhah' (advice) mean in Quran 2:275 according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith, transmitted through the prominent chain of al-Kulayni, offers a concise exegetical definition where 'maw'idhah' is equated with 'tawbah', emphasizing that true repentance serves as the mechanism for divine forgiveness of past sins. It highlights the Shia scholarly focus on the transformative power of repentance as the immediate cessation of sin upon receiving divine reminder, linking spiritual awareness directly to moral rectification.
